title: Balancing Arguments in a Labour Interview
goal: Weigh counter-arguments with contrast markers and read an expert interview on the changing labour market.
grammar: contrast markers en cambio, por el contrario, no obstante and ahora bien

items: I can distinguish *en cambio*, *por el contrario*, *no obstante* and *ahora bien* in formal argument.
I can discuss the pay gap, minimum wage, restructuring, contract types and work-life balance.
I can follow an expert interview on hybrid work, automation and labour-market trends.
